tail -c 1800 /tmp/edge_control.out; echo ====; python3 - <<'PY'
import glob, json, os, time, collections
rows=[]
seen=set()
for d in sorted(glob.glob('/opt/trading-bot/positions*')):
    try:
        pos=json.load(open(d+'/positions.json')); orders={o['id']:o for o in json.load(open(d+'/orders.json'))}
    except Exception: continue
    for p in pos:
        if p.get('t_out') is None: continue
        o=orders.get(p.get('order_id'))
        if not o or not o.get('chan') or o.get('setup')=='breakout' or o.get('rule') in ('retest_up','retest_down'): continue
        k=(p['sym'],int(p['t_in']),p['side'])
        if k in seen: continue
        seen.add(k); rows.append(p)
ts=[int(p['t_in']) for p in rows]
print('trades',len(rows),'from',time.strftime('%F %H:%M',time.gmtime(min(ts)/1000)),'to',time.strftime('%F %H:%M',time.gmtime(max(ts)/1000)))
by=collections.defaultdict(list)
for p in rows: by[(time.strftime('%m-%d',time.gmtime(int(p['t_in'])/1000)),p['side'])].append(float(p.get('r_mult') or 0))
days=sorted({k[0] for k in by})
print('day   LONG n avgR | SHORT n avgR')
for dd in days:
    l=by.get((dd,'long'),[]); s_=by.get((dd,'short'),[])
    print(dd, '%3d %+.2f | %3d %+.2f'%(len(l), sum(l)/len(l) if l else 0, len(s_), sum(s_)/len(s_) if s_ else 0))
